title: Baby in Stroller, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo, 1957
description: Black and white snapshot taken in December 1957 depicting a 7-month-old baby seated in a vintage metal stroller highchair outdoors in front of a cinder block wall. The photo features a side date stamp of 'DEC . 57' and a handwritten note along the bottom front border detailing the child's age.
